text: How much is an airport taxi to Atlantis?

Great choice! 🌴

An airport taxi from **LPIA → Atlantis/Paradise Island** is **$45**, with the bridge toll already included. That covers up to **3 passengers**.

Need a larger group? Our **group van** (up to 8 pax) is **$90**.

Ready to book? You can reserve in advance at [roxtaxi.com/taxi](#) or I can help you get started right here! 🚖
Hi Roxi, how much is a taxi from LPIA?

Hi there! Welcome to Rox Taxi & Tours! 😊

The fare from **LPIA Airport** depends on your destination:

| Destination | Price |
|---|---|
| Downtown Nassau / Cable Beach | **$35** |
| Paradise Island / Atlantis / Baha Mar | **$45** *(bridge toll included)* |

Both fares cover **up to 3 passengers**. Need a larger group? We have **van transfers for up to 8 pax at $90**. 🚐

Ready to book or have any other questions? You can also book directly at **rox.taxi/taxi** anytime! 🚕
How do I pay with Zelle?

Great question! Here's how to pay with **Zelle**:

1. **Open your Zelle app** (or your bank's app if Zelle is built in)
2. **Send payment** to our registered Zelle account — contact us directly for our Zelle details to ensure you have the correct info
3. **Include your name + booking reference** in the memo so we can match your payment

📱 You can also reach us on **Facebook** for quick payment coordination: [facebook.com/roxtaxiservice](https://www.facebook.com/roxtaxiservice/)
